description: She wears an opaque rust-red floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow tan-gold woven geometric borders edge the neckline, sleeves, front skirt opening and hem. A cream underdress shows along the lower central opening. A patterned tan, brown, muted red and dark green wrap lies around her forearms and hangs at both sides. A narrow decorated belt has round metal ornaments and a long patterned hanging end. A fine dark necklace with a small round gold pendant is visible. Dark brown closed-toe shoes show beneath the skirt. No headgear or weapons appear.
